answer: When you sell us a car you still owe money on, we confirm what you owe at the appointment and pay the lender off directly from your offer. The help center doesn't say how long it takes for the loan to show as paid off, so please contact a store for timing. No, don't skip your next payment: keep making your regular payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off, because a missed payment can be reported as late on your credit history. If a payment goes through after the payoff, your lender refunds the extra to you, usually within 2 to 4 weeks after the loan is closed.

facts.fact: the payoff goes to the lender the same day, because Northwind Auto Finance is in the e-payoff network
keep making payments until the lender confirms the loan is paid off
